scenes.title: What is a profile?
scenes.narration: A DataWedge profile defines how data is captured, optionally formatted, and delivered to an associated application.

scenes.title: 1. Input
scenes.narration: Input controls how data is acquired. For example, a barcode scan provides the data to be processed.

scenes.title: 2. Process
scenes.narration: Processing can format the captured data if needed. This stage is optional.

scenes.title: 3. Output
scenes.narration: Output controls how the data reaches the associated app. A profile connects these stages from capture to delivery.
